commands.name: search-registry
commands.summary: Full-text search over one registry index (providers, modules, provider docs, policy libraries or run tasks) using the site's Algolia search

commands.name: search-modules
commands.summary: Search modules by keyword using the public v1 registry API, optionally filtered by provider, namespace or verified status

commands.name: list-providers
commands.summary: Browse providers, filtered by tier, category or namespace, with sorting and pagination

commands.name: list-modules
commands.summary: Browse modules, filtered by provider or namespace, with latest version info, sorting and pagination

commands.name: get-module
commands.summary: Get the latest version of a module: description, source, inputs, outputs, resources, submodules and the list of all versions

commands.name: get-module-version
commands.summary: Get one specific version of a module, including its submodules (v2 API)

commands.name: list-module-versions
commands.summary: List all published versions of a module

commands.name: get-module-downloads
commands.summary: Get a module's download counts (week, month, year, total) by its numeric module id

commands.name: get-provider
commands.summary: Get provider details plus all of its provider-versions (the included versions carry the numeric provider-version ids that list-provider-docs needs)

commands.name: list-provider-versions
commands.summary: List every version of a provider with its supported protocols and OS/arch platforms (public v1 API)

commands.name: get-provider-downloads
commands.summary: Get a provider's download counts (week, month, year, total) by its numeric provider id

commands.name: list-provider-docs
commands.summary: List the documentation pages (resources, data sources, guides, functions) of one provider version

commands.name: find-provider-doc
commands.summary: Look up a provider doc page by provider-version id, category and slug (e.g. the aws_vpc resource) to get its doc id

commands.name: get-provider-doc
commands.summary: Get the full markdown content of one provider documentation page by doc id

commands.name: get-provider-download
commands.summary: Get the download URL, SHA256 sum and signing keys for a provider binary for a given version, OS and architecture

commands.name: list-policies
commands.summary: Browse Sentinel/OPA policy libraries, optionally by namespace, with pagination

commands.name: get-policy-library
commands.summary: Get a policy library's details and its versions

commands.name: get-policy-library-version
commands.summary: Get one version of a policy library together with the individual policies it contains

commands.name: list-run-tasks
commands.summary: Browse HCP Terraform run-task integrations, optionally filtered by category

commands.name: list-categories
commands.summary: List categories (id, name, slug) used to filter providers, policy libraries or run tasks

commands.name: get-namespace-profile
commands.summary: Get the GitHub profile (name, avatar, location, website, bio) behind a registry namespace
